a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 almost certainly leaves both of us empty when a storm hits. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, which is enough to secure one unit. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't pretend otherwise. If you'd rather propose a different split or plan, tell me. I'm not going to hide my move from you.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round, so I've broken our agreement, openly. The reserve is now 0. If no storm hits, I'll operate with you so the generator can refill the reserve for your unit. I won't take anything more.
